build_UnpooledResnet50: build an UnpooledResnet50 model with a specified number of output classes for classification
create_ResNet: create a ResNet model with a custom block type, layer depths, and group normalization
run_Bottleneck_forward: run a Bottleneck block forward pass on input tensor with 1x1-3x3-1x1 conv pattern
test_BasicBlock: test a BasicBlock residual unit with two 3x3 convolutions and identity skip connection
review_conv3x3_conv1x1: review the conv3x3 and conv1x1 helper functions that create padded Conv2d layers
